# Load data

## Raw data
```{r cars}
# Set the directory path
directory <- "/Volumes/group-1/h345/afarkkilab/Data/17_Auria_TMA/csv/raw"

# Target sample names
samples <- c('19_02_02A', '19_02_01A', 'T2', 'INF2', '19_02_03A', '1B', '2B', '3B', 'INF1')

# Get all file names in the directory
files <- list.files(directory, pattern = "_raw.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

# Filter files that match the condition
files_to_merge <- files[sapply(files, function(f) {
  sample_name <- gsub("_raw.csv$", "", basename(f))  # Extract sample name
  sample_name %in% samples  # Check if sample name is in the target list
})]

# If there are matching files, read and merge them
if (length(files_to_merge) > 0) {
  # Read all files with specified encoding
  data_list <- lapply(files_to_merge, function(f) {
    tryCatch({
      # Attempt to read with UTF-8 encoding, adjust if necessary
      read.csv(f, fileEncoding = "UTF-8", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("Error reading file:", f, "\n", e$message, "\n")
      NULL  # Return NULL in case of error
    })
  })
  
  # Remove any NULL values from the list (in case of errors)
  data_list <- data_list[!sapply(data_list, is.null)]
  
  # If there are any valid files, merge them
  if (length(data_list) > 0) {
    merged_data <- do.call(rbind, data_list)
    
    # Save the merged data
    output_file <- "/Users/wenqchen/Desktop/Projects/Auria/Data/t-CycIF/raw_merged_data.csv"
    write.csv(merged_data, output_file, row.names = FALSE)
    
    cat("Merge complete, file saved to:", output_file, "\n")
  } else {
    cat("No valid files to merge.\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("No matching files found.\n")
}

```

# UMAP
```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}


umap_s = uwot::umap(df[,c(1:10)], n_neighbors=80, scale=F, spread=1, min_dist=0.5, n_epochs=50)

uplot = data.frame(x = umap_s[,1], y= umap_s[,2], cell_type = add_data$celltype_1, imageid = add_data$imageid, RCNs=add_data$RCNs)
uplot <- na.omit(uplot)

p = ggplot(uplot, aes(x,y, color=imageid)) + 
  geom_point(size=0.5, stroke=0, alpha=0.7) + 
  theme_bw() +
  coord_fixed(ratio=1) +
  scale_color_manual(values=moma.colors("Warhol",n=10)) +
  xlab("umap1") + ylab("umap2") +
  theme(legend.position="right") +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size=5, shape=15, alpha=1)))

print(p)



```
